whereWaveBuilds: The highest-convexity move is a snapback in the AI-capex chain and nuclear/power dislocation: AVGO (tier A, score 81) with 23.9% revenue growth at -28.7% from its high, and BWXT/VST/NXT at -36% to -50% with revenue recovering and insider buying — the first green volume day in either complex is the probe trigger; the risk is the META-led momentum sprint reversing into a low VIX and dragging sentiment with it before the Oct 14 CPI.
